Description: Maintain batch expiry visibility and ensure correct batches are selected and presented for dispensing.
Create purchase orders at configured thresholds, dispatch requests and provide supplier visibility.
Keep the stock-management engine available during pharmacy operating hours.

As a pharmacy inventory clerk, I want to view batch expiry dates and see a warning for batches expiring within 30 days, so that I can act on at-risk medicine stock before it expires. Acceptance criteria: Each batch has an expiry date; a visual indicator appears for batches expiring within 30 days; the warning is visible in the relevant batch list.

As a pharmacy clerk, I want the system to select the valid batch with the nearest expiry date during sales checkout, so that medicines are dispensed in First-Expired-First-Out order. Acceptance criteria: Compare expiry dates of valid available batches; select the nearest valid expiry first; do not select a newer batch while an older unexpired batch is available. Dependency: US-01.

Summary: FEFO dispensing list for the clerk
Description: As a pharmacy clerk, I want to generate a dispensing list sorted by batch expiry date, so that I can retrieve stock in the correct FEFO order. Acceptance criteria: Generate a clerk list; nearest valid expiry dates appear at the top; order is expiry-date ascending. Dependency: US-01.

As an inventory manager, I want the system to create a draft purchase order when an item reaches its predefined minimum stock threshold, so that replenishment work begins before a medicine shortage occurs. Acceptance criteria: A minimum threshold can be set; when stock falls below it a draft PO is created immediately; the draft contains item and trigger context.

Summary: Secure and timely supplier purchase-order dispatch
Description: As a purchasing manager, I want the system to generate and dispatch a supplier purchase-order request when stock dips below the safety threshold, so that replenishment requests are sent reliably and securely. Acceptance criteria: Automatically generate and dispatch at threshold; benchmark under simulated peak load; check against latency/security targets agreed by the team/instructor (no numeric targets were specified in Lab 1). Dependency: US-04.

Summary: Supplier view of dispatched purchase orders
Description: As an inventory supplier, I want to view purchase orders dispatched to me, so that I can see the orders that require supplier action. Acceptance criteria: Supplier view displays dispatched POs; all system-dispatched POs are visible; supplier can distinguish dispatched orders. Dependency: US-05.

As a pharmacy administrator, I want the stock-management engine to remain available for 99.9% of pharmacy operating hours, so that pharmacy stock operations can continue reliably. Acceptance criteria: Availability is monitored/logged during pharmacy hours; evidence demonstrates 99.9% uptime; downtime remains below 43 minutes per month.
